notes.title: Amygdala 2.9.0 - Personal Room, General Fix & Gameplay adjustments
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Virtual Photo event ends today and with that comes an update for Amygdala!
Amygdala updates to a new version 2.9.0 and adds, corrects and modifies some functions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/a61d4eaaa24358d032c4176086d4747b921f94a8.jpg

Amygdala 2.9.0 - Update Info


[code] To avoid compatibility problems with save games I recommend everyone start a new game. Otherwise you may encounter unwanted issues due to some non-retroactive gameplay changes. [/code]


 Personal Room: Inside the Amygdala there is now a personal room, with no function other than to let the Nightmare Seeker relax. Inside the Personal Room you will find the three paintings of the three screens chosen during the Virtual Photo Event. it is likely to be expanded in future updates.
 New Achievement: A new Achievement related to the Personal Room has been added.
 General Bug Fixs: Some bugs have been fixed, however it is possible there are others, don't forget to let me know via steam threads, I will try to fix them as soon as possible.
 Beauty Nightmare - Part II, gameplay change Some changes have been made to reduce the redundancy of searching and using keys. [spoiler] In the second part of the beauty nightmare, the player had to find two keys inside the cells to open two doors on the sides of the trapped heart. Now the player will have to turn off the monitors inside the cells in order to destroy the organic blocks and continue into the side rooms.[/spoiler]
 Emergency switches removed: The emergency switches were buttons that were used to eliminate the final door when a bug occurred, but they confused the player. Now it seems that the bug no longer occurs (in the final door), so these buttons have been removed.


Special thanks to all the participants of the Virtual Photo Event, selected, they were all beautiful screens!
Three honorable mentions present within the game as painted:

ZEUS - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3185971817
Warchief - https://x.com/Warchief____/status/1769768797622169698
Angela M McCann - https://x.com/anmanarrative/status/1769112643304931527

New updates are expected in the future, I'll let you know! 
Thanks for the support!

notes.title: Amygdala v2.8 - Gameplay Overhaul, Improvement & New Content
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is the fourth day of the game's release, I'm happy to see that all the previous fixes made resolve most of the issues, both bug related and game optimization related.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/03b80734a9309f9aecd72627facaff5f4f2ddbaa.png

So in these two days I dedicated myself to improving the overall gaming experience. I've seen several streamers playing Amygdala, collected feedback and listened to all the doubts related to some mechanics, so...Today Amygdala is updated to version 2.8!

An important note below:

If you started the game on previous versions, you may encounter bugs due to the conflict between an old and new version of the game, this is because big changes have been made between one version and another, I therefore invite everyone to play a new game in order to avoid bugs.

I know this may be frustrating for some, but it improves the overall experience.

Amygdala v2.8 

Gameplay:

 General: All general collisions have been improved, it is now easier to pick up keys and interact with gates.
General: All initial tutorials have now been moved to the HUB, plus some last longer before disappearing to allow for better reading
Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: The way up has been further improved, collisions now let the player go up without too many problems and there is now an arrow to indicate the beginning of the path.
Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: The books to take now have a bright outline, which makes them more visible and clear in interaction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/b7b9fcc64638a095814decc96321648462f89658.jpg

Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: The books now have Roman numerals on the pages, which better identify which mouth it should be given to.
Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: in the environment near the mouths to feed there are now symbols that identify which books I want to eat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/e8c9426d8f0fbad187bd7bbfe46cd84ea68a2282.jpg

Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: Fixed some things related to the AI, it is now much slower and tries to attack you from a greater distance, this will make it more difficult to body block you.
Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: New path have been added, this will allow you to bypass monsters in case its AI freezes, this prevents it from body blocking you.
Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge: Some "necks" of the small mouths have been shrunk, now it is possible to take the key without having to necessarily feed all three mouths in the corridor. This change favors different gameplay approaches.
Nightmare of Beauty: Fixed some things related to the AI, it is now much slower and tries to attack you from a greater distance, this will make it more difficult to body block you.
Nightmare of Beauty:  New path have been added, this will allow you to bypass monsters in case its AI freezes, this prevents it from body blocking you.
Nightmare of Beauty:  Changed the positioning of some levers outside the cells, so it is possible to open them from the inside if you lock yourself inside.
Big Heads Nightmare: Altars now have different colored and glowing symbols that identify which heads to place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/f74d46358219a0b41b9f12238cc1f59ff2ed5e7e.png

Big Heads Nightmare: Rooms that have heads for altars now have symbols on them that better identify the importance of the room and which head is for which altar.


New Content:

 Steam: New steam achievement "Echo - Amygdala 1994.07.31" Get one echo inside the Amygdala 1994.07.31.
 General: Added documents that justify and insert into the game lore all the changes made at the gameplay level.
 Amygdala HUB: There are five new echoes inside the HUB.
Amygdala HUB: The paths in the side stairs have been cleared, you can now go under the absolute judge without having to climb up the books in a tricky way.
Amygdala HUB: Fixed some books clipping in bookshelves.
Big Heads Nightmare: Added audio files for an "angry personality" head (one of the three heads that must be brought to the altar).


Thank you all for your feedback and patience. I definitely plan to add more (free) content to the title in the future. I currently have no further patches in the works, for now I will collect more feedback for future updates.

PS. I am also collecting feedback to adjust the minimum and recommended requirements on the Steam page. 

Thank you all!

notes.title: Amygdala - Major Performance Optimizations & Bug Fixing
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is the second day of release for Amygdala and I have worked hard to promptly resolve all the various problems, today's update which is now available is the biggest and improves various aspects of the game, especially performance;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/1fe57951449bcb50126600abcea94365b98be258.png

The changes made are mainly:

Performance:

 At everyone's advice, excessive motion blur has been removed.
 Streaming management of levels (loading) has been improved.
 The total weight of the game has been reduced from +7GB to 1.3GB.
 Other minor adjustments

Bug Fixies & others:

 Fixed the "Rusty Key Mid Floor" key not properly opening the gate inside the Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge. (If you had already found the key it may still not work, but in the same place where you found the previous one the working one may have appeared)
 Added organic decorative elements to the gate in Mid Floor, Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge to make it clearer which part of the gate is interactable with the key.
 The way to climb in the Nightmare of Insatiable Knowledge at the beginning has been improved, improving collisions, now it is easier (will be improved more in the future with updates)
  Now you can no longer bring objects into the safe rooms: This created problems, such as the disappearance of books or other things.
 A lore-friendly document has been inserted regarding the impossibility of bringing objects into the safe rooms.
  Added controller compatibility to the steam page (if there are any compatibility problems let me know) | Although I recommend playing the title with mouse and keyboard


Now I will wait for your feedback to understand how to proceed further;
By the end of next week I will take a break of about 1 week but then I will actively return to work!

Also I wanted to say that I saw the Preview Key requests for streamers & curators via email, I'm not ignoring you, after the break I will check all the emails carefully and I will try to answer you!

Special Thanks to Tainted Pact Games (https://twitter.com/TaintedPact) Who gave me some vital and excellent advice regarding performance optimization

Sorry for the delay in replies but I'm actually giving priority to bug fixing!

Thank you all for the feedback and continued support! ❤️
- Antonino

notes.title: Amygdala - Hotfix & General Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Amygdala was released yesterday but some annoying bugs have undermined the experience of some, some hotfixes have been released and correct most of the problems, especially the softlock ones!

Thanks for all the feedback, I also want to encourage those who enjoyed the experience and were lucky enough not to run into any serious bugs to share their review on steam, it helps a lot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/8449f1fb1906538ce7cc0375df429c9c3229f7ff.png


Last night I also took a look at Twitch, it was nice to see the game streamed and also very informative on some corrections to be made!

The released patches resolve the following issues:


Bigger Keys - Now the keys are bigger it should be easier to see them, if you still have problems let me know and I will find a better solution to make them more visual.
Fixed the bug in the "insatiable knowledge" level - When approaching a book to feed the mouth-shaped creatures, a bug may occur that causes the hud to disappear and therefore the possibility of interactions, this bug should be resolved, However, I recommend throwing the book at the creatures to avoid possible problems... it's even more fun!. (once you have them in your hand, press mouse 1 to throw them)
Fixed some bugs where there were no collisions in the large holes on the wall in the second part of the nightmare of the big head;
The trigger box for the gramophone kinematics is now larger.
 FIX 2: Now there is some keys at the end of the nightmares and at the beginning of the nightmare of insatiable knowledge, in case you are softlocated they should help you unlock the contextual path. And add this feature to make sure you are no longer softlocker here: when you take the key an anomaly made a glitch on the screen will make you understand that the door has been unlocked or destroyed by the key collection event. It's possible that the key remains in the inventory as a... souvenir from the Absolute Judge.
Improved collisions for climbing onto books and added wooden beams to make climbing to the start of the Insatiable Knowledge level easier.
In the level of insatiable knowledge the two keys now have different names to better identify them, furthermore the first key is removed from the inventory after use.
Bugs have been fixed in the level of insatiable knowledge where creatures with book-shaped heads did not perform some animations correctly.
Fixed a bug with a "Happy Family" steam achievement, now you unlock it correctly after catching the small insect hidden in the beauty's nightmare.
added some Echo dococument to make "bugs" and "reporting them"... lore friendly.


Thanks everyone for your patience, remember I'm a single person working on the game, I didn't have the opportunity or budget to do various tests before release!

Thanks again to understand! ❤️

notes.title: Amygdala Performance Benchmark Tool, New Screenshots & more info!
notes.content:
We are now only two weeks away from the release of Amygdala! So it's time to give you the latest information and tools before release, so you're ready to face the nightmares of Amygdala.

What will the price of Amygdala be at launch?
The fixed price of Amygdala will be $9.94. 
At the launch of the game there will be a 33% discount for 14 days.

Amygdala Performance Benchmark Tool

Amygdala is a video game developed by a single person using Unreal Engine 5. Because of this the optimization is really limited for obvious reasons (resources, budget & much more). For more details, refer to the old "before buying" article.

This tool was designed to give everyone the opportunity to test Amygdala two weeks before release in order to evaluate whether or not to purchase it based on its correct functioning in terms of performance.

This benchmark test does not represent the final version of the game, in fact several aesthetic elements may be different, this is a test exclusively to test the performance of the title before purchasing.

This benchmark test will be included in the full game for free.


[hr][/hr]Download Amygdala Performance Benchmark Tool (6GB)
Preview Video
Amygdala Performance Benchmark Tool - Preview 
[hr][/hr]

How to use
Before downloading, make sure you have approximately 6 GB of data space available on your computer

Download the zip
Extract the contents 
 Open the folder "AmygdalaBenchmark" and start AmygdalaBenchmark.exe


Is this a Demo?
No, it's not a demo, it's a tool.

What is a "Performance Benchmark Tool"?

Performance Benchmark Tool is a stress test that will test your hardware in the most complex and demanding area of Amygdala on Unreal Engine 5.

Through different game shots in real time, the progress of your FPS (Frame per second) will be calculated over time and at the end of the test you will be given a summary evaluation.

How do I know if the game will work well?

When you start the benchmark you will be able to evaluate the fluidity of the game and the visual quality yourself

I recommend a performance of 30FPS to ensure that the title is playable, 60FPS for the best possible experience.

But keep in mind that this is still a stress test, performance in the full game may be different.

Low FPS, high-performance PC, why?
As previously mentioned, this situation it is given by the optimization, at the end of the benchmark an evaluation will be displayed with the components of your PC, if you want to share this info with the community it would help to understand on which hardware it works better or worse.

From personal experience, the game runs very well with an nvidia GPU. But here, I'm basing it on the limited testing of two PCs.

[hr][/hr]
Amygdala New Screenshots! In these new screenshots you will be able to see new creatures and areas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/052959898a889c66dd08952bc23bfca10908d117.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/ce72f94ba250b0c1b346d0176974562570876178.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/66021d27a4ef578da6fc6f4076e1d36774f68232.jpg

[hr][/hr]
...More pre-launch info!

Will there be a demo of Amygdala?
No, there will be no demos for Amygdala. 
The title is already a short game in itself, it focuses a lot on the first experience and the surprise effect, in my vision a demo for Amygdala could compromise the final experience.

What is the completion time for Amygdala?

Hard to say since I've only tried it myself. Knowing well where to find each object and the path to take. My longest run, exploring everything was about 2 hours. I won't lie and inflate the title;

But the game can be speedrun and finished in just under 30 minutes.
I didn't lengthen the game with bland content or make it difficult for the sake of locking the player into play time.

I hope you will appreciate this transparency, please do not abuse Steam's refund option.

Will there be achievements and cards?
Yes, the achievements will be available at launch, as far as the compatibility of the cards is concerned, the title must first be eligible by the Steam regulation, once done it will have total compatibility!

Launch event

I'm also happy to announce that during the first few days of the game's release there will be an Amygdala social event on steam, more information on this event later in time;

I hope I have been clear in everything, feel free to ask anything, I will try to answer everyone!

[hr][/hr]Thanks for the support ❤️
Antonino Truisi[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Amygdala - Release Date
notes.content:
Amygdala: The Nightmare Begins on March 15, 2024!

Dark, sinister, and ready to awaken your deepest fears - Amygdala is the horror game that will forever change how you perceive terror and mystery. Get ready to plunge into various nightmares!

 Before pre-ordering or purchasing your copy of Amygdala, ensure that your PC meets the required performance and that you are familiar with the game's development approach. HERE you can find more information for complete transparency! 

Key Features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/62413ac3b90afb94d1f95ee67edf08805523521b.png

👁️‍🗨️Explore the Darkness: Every corner, every corridor, every room is permeated by menacing darkness. Use the Eye of the Amygdala to see beyond, as darkness can hide or reveal the terror that awaits you. But be cautious, some things are better left unknown.

🎭 Unique Creatures: Encounter monstrous and detailed creatures, immerse yourself in a mysterious lore that will envelop you in its enigma.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44648406/9f7fdd1eaeb441adaf92766fc39f05b5f45ada7e.png

👹 Monstrous Aesthetics: Revel in the grotesque beauty of the monsters. The stunning visual design brings these creatures to life with a horrifying aesthetic that will haunt your nightmares.

🎵 Disturbing Sound: Immersive sound design that will send shivers down your spine. Sinister whispers and unsettling sounds intertwine to create a unique and chilling audio experience.

🌌 Breathtaking Graphics:  Ultra-realistic graphics that bring a horror world to life with extraordinary details. You will be catapulted into a dimension where fear takes shape, and nightmares come to life.

📅 Release Date:  March 15, 2024

Get ready to immerse yourself in the beauty of the horror within these nightmares. 
Amygdala awaits you.
